card.name: Casual blog and forum chatter words
card.fires_on: Common short words in informal blog posts, forum replies and email-style text, such as 'today', 'late', 'all', 'this', 'back' and 'always'. They sit in chatty remarks like thanks, apologies and sign-offs.
